summary: VERIFICATION FINDING: EXP-451 hardening patches P2/P3a/P3b/P4/P5 are NOT on the live site — only P1 landed (it reached data/sections.json). The other four+ patches were applied to docs/index.html (a build artifact) and reverted on the next build.js rebuild because the canonical source build-scripts/generate-html.js (which uses template literals like ${counts.total}) was never patched. ISS-2518 was closed 2026-06-03 with closure_reason claiming P1-P5 integrated into docs/index.html — FALSE for P2-P5 (verified by grep against a fresh origin/main clone). EXP-589 re-anchors all five patches to build-scripts/generate-html.js with byte-exact, uniqueness-verified find_text.
next_actions_for_decider: Apply EXP-589 STRESSTEST-P2/P3a/P3b/P4/P5-rev2 to build-scripts/generate-html.js (NOT docs/index.html).
Run `node build.js html` to regenerate docs/index.html, then `node build.js` / tests.
Verify each NEW phrase is present in rebuilt docs/index.html and each OLD phrase is gone.
Only then close ISS-2284/2285/2286 and flip EXP-451 tracker status off holes-being-revised.

Consider re-opening or annotating ISS-2518: its closure_reason claims an integration that did not survive rebuild (build-drift false-closure). The integrity agent`s build-drift check may also flag this.
caveat_other_side: Charitable read: the prior agents did verify against docs/index.html and at that instant the edits may genuinely have been present; the failure is the rebuild step silently reverting non-canonical edits, not a fabricated closure. Either way the live site lacks P2-P5, so re-integration to canonical source is required regardless of how the gap arose.
